name: Security Sensitive Change
description: Changes authentication, tokens, permissions, secrets, or other high-risk code.

name: Duplicate Logic
description: Logic repeats existing behavior and may diverge across modules.

name: Architecture Coupling
description: A change creates tight dependencies, cycles, or cross-layer leakage.

name: Maintainability
description: Code is harder to review, test, or safely evolve.

name: Review Concern
description: General human review concern that needs investigation.
